definition.nl: Het combineren van akkerbouw of tuinbouw met veehouderij op één bedrijf zodat voer, mest en gewasresten onderling kunnen worden benut.
definition.en: Combining arable or horticultural crops with livestock on one farm so that resources such as feed, manure and crop residues can be cycled internally.

en: Bilingual definition drafted for the PoC; requires validation by ReGeNL domain experts. Previous source definitions are retained in regenlmeta:originalDefinition.

prefLabel.nl: Delen van middelen tussen akkerbouw en melkveehouderij
prefLabel.en: resource sharing, collaboration between arable production and dairy
